declarations.name: ImgEnlargeElement
declarations.description: Enhance one authored image with a modal enlarged view. Unnamed images open independently; matching nonempty name attributes opt into galleries. Preserve light-DOM image links and responsive sources. Shared labels come from inline script[type='application/json'][data-img-enlarge-config]: an empty marker sets page defaults; a value targets that gallery name. Each script accepts a flat label object or language dictionaries selected by inherited lang with regional-to-base fallback. Merge per key: individual label attributes, named configuration, page configuration, built-in English defaults. Valid unchanged JSON is cached per script. Refresh after editing configuration or inherited language. Duplicate scripts for an applicable scope or invalid configuration emit a configuration error and preserve authored content. No availability probes or enlargement downloads run before opening. Known thumbnail dimensions reserve the enlarged image box while loading or failed. Failed images stay visible with native browser fallback rendering, error status, Retry, and Close. Successful images use their own proportions.

members.name: state
members.description: Connection, responsive eligibility, configuration, and modal state; inactive means enlargement adds no space or no larger inferred responsive candidate remains. Image loading errors do not close the modal.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Close the viewer and reread image markup, component configuration, page JSON labels, and inherited language. Preserve focus on a replacement opener until focus leaves.

members.name: open
members.description: Initialize pending connected collection members and open a snapshot at this image, preserving each authored image's referrerpolicy and crossorigin before requesting enlarged sources. A viewer opened by the previous viewer's close listener takes precedence over the interrupted opening.

members.name: close
members.description: Close and remove the viewer, restoring opener focus when connected.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Explicit enlarged image URL; overrides image-link and original-candidate inference. Without component src or srcset, use the authored image's enclosing image link before responsive candidate inference. Recognize an image MIME type hint or, without a nonempty type hint, an apng, avif, bmp, gif, ico, jfif, jpg, jpeg, png, svg, or webp pathname extension, case-insensitively and ignoring query/fragment. The fallback is authored currentSrc, then src. HTTP(S), blob, and image data URLs only.

attributes.name: srcset
attributes.description: Explicit responsive enlargement candidates; override image-link and original-candidate inference. Without explicit sources or an identified image link, infer width candidates from the authored image or unambiguous selected picture branch; density descriptors use loaded natural dimensions. Original markup is preserved.

attributes.name: sizes
attributes.description: Optional enlarged-image sizes. Overrides the measured painted width for inferred candidates; browser defaults apply to explicit srcset when absent.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Plain-text caption, overriding the image's enclosing figure figcaption. Empty suppresses the caption.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Case-sensitive gallery name. Matching nonempty names opt into a shared collection in document order; absent or empty opens only this image. Also selects a matching data-img-enlarge-config label script.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Use supported CSS scroll buttons or force JavaScript-generated buttons.

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: Always offer enlargement, even when the displayed image is as large as the styled viewer would show it or the largest inferred responsive candidate is already selected.

attributes.name: previous-label
attributes.description: Nonempty previous control name for both control paths.

attributes.name: next-label
attributes.description: Nonempty next control name for both control paths.

attributes.name: position-label
attributes.description: Nonempty position template containing both {current} and {total}.

events.name: img-enlarge:open
events.description: Bubbles from the opener after opening; detail has zero-based index, total, and the current component.

events.name: img-enlarge:change
events.description: Bubbles from the opener on the initial selection and each changed selection.

events.name: img-enlarge:close
events.description: Bubbles from the opener after teardown, with empty detail.

events.name: img-enlarge:error
events.description: Bubbles with error, phase (configuration, open, or load), and the affected component.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-trigger-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Enlarge button inset from the image's block-start edge.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-trigger-inset-inline-end
cssProperties.description: Enlarge button inset from the image's inline-end edge.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-control-size
cssProperties.description: Minimum icon-control size, also used to size centered navigation controls.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-control-inset
cssProperties.description: Close and navigation control inset from the dialog edges.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-dialog-padding
cssProperties.description: Dialog padding, reserving room for overlaid controls.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-dialog-inline-size
cssProperties.description: Preferred dialog inline size, capped to the viewport.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-dialog-gap
cssProperties.description: Gap between the dialog's grid rows.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-slide-gap
cssProperties.description: Inline gap between full-width gallery slides, providing separation against fractional scroll rounding.

cssProperties.name: --img-enlarge-image-max-block-size
cssProperties.description: Maximum block size of enlarged images.

cssProperties.name: --disabled-button-visibility
cssProperties.description: Visibility of disabled navigation arrows in both control paths. Set hidden to hide them without shifting layout; focused arrows remain visible until focus leaves.

declarations.name: defineImgEnlarge
declarations.description: Register img-enlarge when a browser registry exists; called automatically on import. Return false without a registry, true otherwise.
